description: This file implements a local cache layer for auto-translation features in Mattermost, including cache key generation, cache invalidation, and retrieval of user auto-translation settings, user language preferences, and post translation timestamps.

classes.name: LocalCacheAutoTranslationStore
classes.description: A cache layer for auto-translation data, managing cache keys, invalidation, and retrieval for user auto-translation settings, user language preferences, and post translation timestamps.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateUserAutoTranslation
methods.description: Handles invalidation of user auto-translation cache entries based on cluster messages.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidatePostTranslationEtag
methods.description: Handles invalidation of post translation etag cache entries based on cluster messages.

methods.name: IsUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if auto-translation is enabled for a user in a channel, utilizing cache.

methods.name: GetUserLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the user's language preference for a channel, with caching.

methods.name: InvalidateUserAutoTranslation
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific user and channel.

methods.name: InvalidateUserLocaleCache
methods.description: Invalidates all language caches for a user across channels when locale changes.

methods.name: GetLatestPostUpdateAtForChannel
methods.description: Gets the latest update timestamp for post translations in a channel, with cache.

methods.name: InvalidatePostTranslationEtag
methods.description: Invalidates cached post translation etag for a channel.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a translation and invalidates post translation etag cache if applicable.
